name: 仙影迷踪
detailed_description:
Game Genre and Theme

This is a visual novel game with the themes of campus love and puzzle-solving. Game Mechanics Players click with the mouse to experience the story plot from the first-person perspective and select different options to influence the development of the plot.

Game Story and Background

The player is a student. An accident occurs during the experiment of his postgraduate research project, which causes him to fall into a time mystery. Can the player solve the mystery of time and space? When countless mysteries are unraveled, what will be the final outcome for the player and the person he loves?

Main Attractions of the Game

1. Plot Experience - As a visual novel game, this has a single-storyline script. Therefore, to enhance the gaming experience, when players make decisions during the plot, it will lead to multiple incomplete game results. Although there are different endings, there is only one perfect ending.

2. Visual Effects - I quite like the animation art style of Makoto Shinkai. Thus, the art design of the buildings and characters in the game mainly adopts a 2D animation style, highlighting the atmosphere of the scenes, presenting the lighting effects similar to those in movies and TV shows, and making the players feel more immersed.

3. Sound Effects - There is an earworm looping theme song, as well as highly atmospheric sound effects and background music.
